'''Sofie Juárez''' (born 9 April 1991) is an [[alpine skier]] from [[Andorra]].  She competed for [[Andorra at the 2010 Winter Olympics]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Sofie Juarez |url=http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-alpine-skiing/athletes/sofie-juarez_ath1015020AG.html |website=Vancouver2010.com |publisher=[[Vancouver Organizing Committee for the 2010 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games]] |accessdate=7 October 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100408231337/http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-alpine-skiing/athletes/sofie-juarez_ath1015020AG.html |archive-date=2010-04-08 |url-status=dead}}</ref>  She did not finish either of her events.<ref>{{cite web |title=Biography |url=http://www.fis-ski.com/uk/604/613.html?sector=AL&competitorid=127182&type=result&category=OWG&season=ALL&sort=&discipline=ALL&position=&place=&Submit=Search |publisher=FIS |accessdate=7 October 2011}}</ref><ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Sofie Juárez}}</ref>
